title: How to check your credit score for free
description: You do not need to pay a monthly fee to see your credit score. Here are the trusted ways to check it.
author: Jon Twaddle
body:
Checking your credit score is free. You have a legal right to a free report every week from AnnualCreditReport.com.

Many credit cards also provide your FICO score for free on your monthly statement or in their app. This is typically a real score, not an estimate.

Do not enter your credit card number on a site just to see your score. If they ask for payment information, they are signing you up for a subscription you do not need.

faq.q: Does checking my score lower it?
faq.a: No. Checking your own score is a soft pull and has no impact on your credit.
